frame_transform_mode_note: Explicit Pythonic XYZWPR colon composition, INV and FRAME follow ../frame-transforms.md and ../frame-construction.md; earlier blanket frame exclusions below remain for the future strict milestone. Other transform operand types, implicit positional conversion and controller context remain unsupported.
pos_constructor_mode_note: Public Pythonic POS/XYZWPR construction follows ../pos-construction.md; older constructor exclusions below remain for the future strict milestone. Robot-specific CONFIG validity and implicit POSITION conversion remain unverified.
scope: Chosen offline VEC constructor interpretation, VECTOR unary signs and left-associated cross/dot expression composition

reference_basis.documented: Arithmetic examples use three-component VEC notation; VECTOR comprises X/Y/Z REAL fields; cross/dot precede multiplication and unary/addition
reference_basis.uncertainty: These pages provide no independent controller observation of constructor ABI, unary VECTOR signs, same-level product association or native rounding

implementation_choices.constructor: VEC(x,y,z) accepts initialized finite INTEGER/REAL values, with existing numeric promotions, and creates a fresh writable VECTOR
implementation_choices.name_priority: Explicit internal VEC routines retain precedence, signatures and effect checks; existing ordinary VEC declaration names remain allowed; fallback calls require all three arguments
implementation_choices.signs: Unary plus and minus return independent checked VECTOR copies; every component known, initialized and finite
implementation_choices.products: Cross/dot chains associate left to right, retaining existing precedence and checked intermediate types; parentheses override; VECTOR values captured before later operand effects
implementation_choices.composition: Constructors compose in assignments, field/element storage, function results, private value arguments and explicit component access; SQRT(v@v) computes an ordinary unscaled float length expression
implementation_choices.failure: Existing left-to-right evaluation, finite checks, destination preservation, prior effects, frame cleanup, ownership, POSITION protection and active FOR-counter checks remain
implementation_choices.reports: vector_constructors records source locations, argument order and independent-value flags; vector_policy states the current contract

retained_boundaries: No POS constructor, frame transforms, geometry defaults, kinematics or aggregate CONST values
No ordered VECTOR relations or VECTOR-by-VECTOR multiplication/division
No new native compiler/controller/runtime acceptance; strict mode remains a future milestone with internal conservative guards
